newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swissotel sells four U.S. hotels to Blackstone.
newsitem.headline: Swissotel sells four U.S. hotels to Blackstone.

text.p: Swissotel, the hotel management unit of SAirGroup, said Thursday it had sold its four luxury hotels in the United States to an affiliate of the Blackstone Group, a New York-based investment bank.
As part of the deal, Blackstone has acquired a 25 percent stake in Swissotel's U.S. hotel management company.
Swissotel will continue to manage the four properties, which include the 550-room Swissotel New York, formerly known as the Drake hotel. The other hotels are in Atlanta, Boston and Chicago.

Swissotel manages 15 hotels in Europe, the Middle East, Asia and North America but has set its sights on expanding globally, primarily in Asia. SAirGroup is also the parent company of Swiss national airline Swissair.
The deal creates a partnership that will help Swissotel achieve its goal of managing 60 hotels worldwide by 2000, a Swissotel spokesman said.
The sales price for the four hotels was not given but industry analysts estimated it to be around $400 million, or about $100 million over their book value. The deal is expected to close Aug. 1.
Swissotel was a problem for SAirGroup for many years but finally returned to profitability last year.
Blackstone Real Estate Partners II L.P., the Blackstone affiliate buying the properties, has controlling interests in 40 hotels, valued at more than $1.5 billion.
